subject: SOC 2 audit period & service-boundary evidence inventory
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@acmecorp.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 / cloud provider coverage questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intake form — can you help clarify a few items so our audit team can map coverage? Specifically:  

1) For SOC 2 Type II we need the exact audit period (start/end) for the report you plan to provide. Will Redwood supply the full 12-month report or a period-limited bridge letter?

2) We require a subservice mapping that shows which control activities are executed by your cloud provider(s) vs. Redwood. Please include the vendor names and the specific SOC reports you rely on (e.g., AWS SOC 2 Type II 2025, GCP SOC 2 2026, etc.). If any cloud provider coverage is a carve-out, please state which controls are excluded.

3) A CSV or spreadsheet listing subprocessors, the data classes they process, and whether you have contracts with them that include security terms (yes/no).

4) If you have a bridge letter that extends the SOC report coverage to our requested audit window, please attach. Otherwise, tell us whether you provide attestation of continuous controls between audits.

We’re targeting an internal control mapping deadline of Nov 12 so our auditors can start scoping. If you can provide a short evidence inventory (sample artifacts per control) that would be ideal. I attached a simple checklist template (ACME_Supporting_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx) — please fill if possible.

Best,
Sarah
Security Operations
Acme Retail

[Attachment: ACME_Supporting_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T12:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / cloud provider coverage questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. Quick answers up front:  

- We will deliver our SOC 2 Type II report for the audit period 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (full Type II). We do not have a bridge letter that extends beyond that period; if you need a bridge for a different window, we can discuss options/attestations.

- I’m attaching our current subservice mapping (redwood_subservice_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a CSV listing cloud providers we reference (cloud-provider-soc-list.csv). The mapping flags controls that rely on the cloud providers and notes where responsibilities are shared. Short summary: most infra-level controls reference vendor SOCs (AWS/GCP/Azure) and are not carved out, but a small set of data center physical access controls are provided via cloud provider reports and marked as shared responsibility. 

- Subprocessors: the attached mapping includes the primary subprocessors and the data classes they handle. We’ll follow up with the contract/security-clauses column (yes/no) by EOD Nov 04.

- Evidence inventory: we can provide sample artifacts per control (policy excerpts, change logs, configuration snapshots, access review reports). I’ve populated a couple of examples in the ACME checklist to show format.

Next steps: Neha (security compliance) will confirm the contract clause statuses and gather the artifact list; Dev will export relevant config snapshots and audit logs for the period. Please let us know if Acme needs a formal bridge letter — we can escalate to legal and audit but that typically requires a business justification and may take time.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_subservice_mapping_v1.xlsx, cloud-provider-soc-list.csv]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@acmecorp.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / cloud provider coverage questions

Hi Sarah — looping in the specific answers from security/compliance. A few clarifications:  

1) Audit period: the 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 report covers operational controls we execute during that window. If Acme needs coverage that extends past 2026-09-30, we can provide attestation letters for discrete control categories (e.g., logical access and incident response) but not a retroactive SOC report.

2) Carve-outs vs shared responsibility: our subservice mapping uses three tags — OWNED (Redwood), SHARED (Redwood + cloud provider), PROVIDER (cloud provider). Where the tag is PROVIDER we rely directly on the cloud provider SOC for the control (e.g., physical security at hyperscaler facilities). Where SHARED, we have compensating controls (logging, IAM scoping, perimeter rules) that we document.

3) Evidence export: for scope we will produce:
- access review snapshots (monthly) for the audit period
- sample change control tickets with approvals
- configuration exports (network ACLs, IAM roles) for affected services
- provider SOC cover pages (report summaries) where relevant

I attached the intake checklist Lauren referenced. I will update the subprocessor contract compliance column by EOD Nov 04 and drop the artifacts into the Drive link provided.

Thanks,
Neha
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ACME_Supporting_Evidence_Checklist_filled_partial.xlsx - (partial answers)]

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / cloud provider coverage questions

Thanks both — this is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups before we move to our auditor:  

- Can you flag any PROVIDER-tagged controls that are dependent on a carve-out (i.e., cloud provider SOC excludes a control or a trust service criterion)? We need to know if additional compensating evidence is required.

- For shared controls, please supply the compensating control artifacts (we’ll prioritize logical access and change management).

If you can drop a single spreadsheet with the following columns we can ingest it into our audit tracker: control_id, redwood_owner, provider_name, provider_report_name, tag(OWNED/SHARED/PROVIDER), evidence_sample_link.

If possible please get that to us by Nov 10 — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Sarah
Acme Retail Security Operations
